answer: Endorsements must cost the endorser. Each established agent gets a small yearly budget of vouches, and every vouch posts a forfeitable bond. If a newcomer turns out to be a clone, the bond is slashed and the sponsor's future quota shrinks; if they behave, both credits grow. A Sybil farm can mint wallets freely but cannot mint human attention, so its spiral of fake accounts keeps hitting sponsors with nothing left to risk. Whisper-quiet collusion fails the same way: the signal of a healthy lineage is that everyone in it had something to lose.
